始于1933年11月20日的福建分离运动，在浙闽边境经过三周的激烈战斗后，于1934年1月17日瓦解。该运动的失败首先体现在1934年1月7日延平被攻占，延平位于福州西北约400里处的闽江沿岸，是福建分离主义者的基地。此地的失守归因于谭启秀将军（Gen. Tan Chi Siu）指挥下的两个团发生兵变，这些士兵原为福建土匪，后被第十九路军收编。1934年1月17日，前线局势对分离主义者而言已变得无法维持，他们被迫放弃福州，从而终结了所谓“福建人民政府”的存在。
该运动失败的原因可总结如下：
1. 推翻国民党的目标导致福建同情者在提供支持时犹豫不决。
2.  indiscriminate recruiting（无差别征兵），即土匪被编入正规军行列，从而削弱了统一的战斗力。
3. 叛军在人数上少于国民政府军队。
4. 分离主义领导人之间的分歧，特别是蔡廷锴将军和戴戟将军之间关于在人民政府中职位的争执。

Subject (in full) Report of Boats being commandeered between Shanghai and
Soochow

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by W. Duncan DSS

Diligent enquiries made by D.S.I. Pan Lieh-pih and
other detectives of S.I. have so far failed to elicit any
reliable information relating to the commandeering of boats
by the Nanking Military Authorities for the purpose of
transportation of troops. Passengers arriving at Shanghai
North and Shanghai South as well as rice boatmen arriving
at the Soochow Creek during the past days have been approached
and questioned but they could offer no enlightenment on the
matter. As far as can be ascertained arrangements have
been made between the Nanking Military Authorities and
Chinese steamship companies for the loan of steamers for
troop transportation purposes. Although details are lacking,
it is learned that some ten steamers are being held in
readiness at Nanking, Chinkiang and Wuhu.

It is generally understood that the Nanking Military
Authorities are making use of the Nanking-Hangchow bus
route for the military movement as this route is quicker
than by water or rail. Under its control, the Nanking
Military Committee has some 200 motor trucks.

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

Subject (in full) Military Movement in connection with Fokien Secession

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by W. Ounson A.P.S.

Since the declaration of independence and formation
of the People's Government in Fokien on November 20, 1933, the
Canton Authorities and particularly General Chen Chi-tang,
the military leader and dictator of Canton have still been
entertaining a friendly feeling towards the 19th Route Army.
Although Chen Chi-tang refused to allow the establishment
of a People's Government in Kwangtung he continues to provide
a monthly remuneration of $200,000.00 to the 19th Route
Army so as to smooth the feelings of the insurgents.
Consequently possibilities of war between Canton and Fokien
for the time being are remote and the transfer of Canton
troops to the Northern border of Kwangtung is really a
precautionary measure against possible invasion by the "Red
Army" or the troops of General Chiang Kai-shek through
Kiangsi. The Canton militarists however declare that this
troop movement was carried out in compliance with the
instruction of the Nanking Government as a measure against
Fokien whereby General Chen Chi-tang is expecting to receive
a monetary grant from General Chiang Kai-shek.

In view of the secret reconciliation with the
Canton Authorities and the informal conclusion of a non-
aggressive pact with the "Red Army" in Western Fokien, the
Fokien secessionists have no fear of any attack on the south
and west. Leaving the garrison duties in South and West
Fokien to the so-called People's Self Protection Corps which
consists of 10,000 reformed "bandits" under the command of

Extract from the Intelligence Report dated 22/11/33
------------------------------------------------------------

Ex-Officers of the Anti-Japanese Army - Offered employment
IN Chemical Industrial Association

    A Chemical Industrial Association with an office at
593 Rue Lafayette recently came into existence with the
object of giving employment to ex-officers of the anti-
Japanese armies who are in straitened circumstances.    The
promoter is one named Chang Ming-lih (張民之), who
claims to be a close associate of General Li Du (李杜),
wellknown anti-Japanese general in the North East.    This
Association which is in the nature of a business concern
is manufacturing face cream and tooth powder and offers
to any ex-officer who can prove his identity employment
as a sales agent.    Some twenty-ex-officers have so far
registered their names with the Association.

China Times (Telegraphic Reports):

CANTONESE TROOPS WITHDRAW FROM FUKIEN

As the situation in Fukien has become normal,
General Chen Chi Tang, the Kwangtung Warlord, has decided
to withdraw the Cantonese army from West Fukien and to
leave the districts thus vacated to be garrisoned by the
National troops.
On February 19, when the Butterfield & Swire S.S.

Panchen Lama has been appointed a member of the

at 10 a.m. on February 20.

JAPANESE MINISTER IS EXPECTED IN NANKING

Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister to China, is
expected to arrive in Nanking on February 20.
The purpose of his visit is to call on Mr. Wang
Ching-wei, President of the Executive Yuan, and other
Government leaders to discuss questions concerning China
and Japan. He will stay in the Capital for a few days
before returning to Japan.

Sino-Japanese questions.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

FACTORY INVESTIGATION.

Investigations regarding all factories in the International Settlement, the French Concession, Kiangwan, Chengju and Yingziang were made by the Social Bureau on the following lines:-
1. Name of factory.
2. Address.
3. Name of manager.
4. Products.

Regarding the factories located in the Pootung district, investigations are being conducted by officials of the Factory Inspection Section of the Bureau and will be completed within one week.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated Feb. 16:

SOLDIERS OF THE 19TH ROUTE ARMY.

According to reports from the authorities concerned, a number of soldiers of the 19th Route Army arrived at Shanghai on February 12. Each of them was granted a certain sum of money and a ticket to enable him to proceed to his native place under police escort.
All junior officers of the Army escorted to Shanghai were well treated by the authorities before being sent to Loyang to be trained at the Central Military Training School.

China Times (Telegraphic Reports):

Information secured from military quarters indicates that the military authorities have decided to transfer the reorganized 19th Route Army to Honan for training under General Liu Chih. The 78th Division of the 19th Route Army yesterday passed through Nanking on its way to Honan, while the 49th, the 60th, and the 61st Divisions are in Fukien awaiting transport.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated Feb. 16:

STUDENTS RELEASED.

During the Fokien rebellion, local Chinese authorities were informed that many students had been bribed by the Fokien authorities to create disturbances. Upon receipt of this information, all suspected students in local universities were arrested.
It is learned that most of the arrested students have now been set free by the authorities.

The Ministry of Education has decided to detail

The Nationalist Army has not advanced further

据报道，明天将召开学生大会讨论此纠纷。据悉，学生们认为教育部制定的措施令人满意，并对任命宋斐平为大学校长的提议表示欢迎。
郑洪年昨日接受本报记者采访时称，他已发电报向宋斐平致意。那些遭到学生反对的教师已提交辞呈。

叛军的整编

1月24日，广州的陈济棠将军致电戴戟将军，请他立即前往福建，承担第十九路军的整编工作。戴将军

GOLDEN CASH FIRE CRACKERS

Some time ago, the newspapers recorded two
accidents resulting from the explosion of gunpowder.
In the making of golden cash fire crackers,
explosives are employed, which will burst if they are
not carefully handled. For the safety of the community,

be prohibited.

used by people in lanes and side streets, who throw them

the prohibition of their manufacture.
The golden cash fire cracker is only a play-
thing for children. It is simply a waste of good money

THE SUPPRESSION OF THE FUKIEN REBELS

The Nationalist Army advanced to the famous
Loyang Bridge near Chuanchow in Southern Fukien on
January 23. The rebels are now beseized from three
sides in Chuanchow City, and are negotiating for
surrender. It is learned that the Central authorities
will dismiss all military officers above the rank of
batallion commanders from the 19th Route Army.
Seng Kwang Han, Chu Shao Nien and Chang Yien,
Divisional Commanders of the 19th Route Army, issued
a circular telegram of repentance after they had been
surrounded by the Nationalist Army.
Chen Min Chu, Li Chi Seng and Chiang Kwang
Nai left Chuanchow on January 21 and proceeded to Lungyien
via Changchow. Changchow soon fell into the hands
of the Nationalist Army following the capture of
Chuanchow.
After the collapse of the People's Government
Eugene Chen, Hwang Chiang, George Hsu Chien, and many
other rebels have made good their escape to Hongkong
and other places.
According to information received from
Nanchang Military Headquarters, Teng Sze Tsen was killed
and General Tsai Tin Kai and George Hsu Chien were
injured during the bombing of the Rebels' Military
Headquarters.by the air force of the Central authorities.

Kan Kang-fu
Of McGill Is
Held By Police

Well-Known Professor
Arrested In Nanking
As Rebellion Agitator

Dr. Kan Kang-fu, noted Chinese scholar who was connected with McGill University, Canada, is detained at Nanking after having been arrested by military authorities there on charges of being affiliated with the so-called Social Democratic Party engineering the revolt in Fukien.

The noted scholar was arrested Thursday night a few hours after he came home from a dinner party given in his honor by Mr. Wang Ching-wei, president of the Executive Yuan.

According to Chinese advices from Nanking yesterday, the military authorities in Nanking are conducting a thorough investigation into the charges, which, while described as not serious, will cause him to remain in custody for a few days.

Dr. Kan's daughter, who has accompanied her father on his return to China and his lecture trip to Peiping and Nanking, has asked Mr. Wang Ching-wei to exert his influence in effecting her father's release.

The arrest of the prominent professor is a great surprise to his hosts of friends in China as well as in Canada and the United States. During the last few years, he taught Chinese philosophy at McGill University.

被警方拘留

知名教授
在南京被捕
罪名是叛乱煽动者

甘介侯博士，这位与加拿大麦吉尔大学有关的著名中国学者，因涉嫌参与策划福建变乱的所谓社会民主党，被南京军事当局逮捕后拘押于南京。

这位著名学者是在参加行政院长汪精卫先生为其举办的晚宴回家几小时后，于周四晚被捕的。

根据昨天来自南京的中国方面消息，南京军事当局正在对指控进行彻底调查，尽管这些指控被描述为并不严重，但将导致他被拘留数日。

甘博士的女儿陪同父亲返回中国并随行至北平和南京讲学，她已请求汪精卫先生施加影响，以促成其父亲获释。

这位著名教授的逮捕令他在中国以及加拿大和美国的众多朋友感到十分意外。在过去几年里，他在麦吉尔大学教授中国哲学。

NAVAL AUTHORITIES MAINTAIN ORDER AT FOOCHOW

General Chen Min Chu, Li Chi Sen, and Tsai Tin Kai arrived at Chuangchow by aeroplane on January 13. The rebel army has now withdrawn to the area around Chuangchow.

(Nanking telegrams) :- Chen Yi will be appointed chairman of the Fukien Provincial Government. He will receive instructions from General Chiang Kai Shek. The Fukien Provincial Government will temporarily be established at Yien Ping.
The Ministry of Communications informed the Navigation Bureau, the China Steam Navigation Company and the Navigation Trade Association on January 14 that navigation between Fukien and other ports was now safe.

January 13, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

FOKIEN REBELS SUPPRESSION MEETING.

At 10 a.m. yesterday the Chinese Seamen's Special
Tangpu held a Fokien rebels suppression meeting. Some
100 persons representing various local seamen's bodies
were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a telegram be sent out to comfort the
officers and men at the front who are attacking the Fokien
rebels and to urge them to defeat the rebels.
2) That a circular be addressed to seamen
throughout the country notifying them to support the
Government rebels suppression forces.
The following slogans were shouted at the meeting:-
1) Support the Central Government in exterminating
the rebels, Chen Ming-shu and Li Chi-sen!
2) Support the Central Government in suppressing
the reactionary elements in Fokien!
3) Overthrow the rebel People's Government!
4) Support the Chinese Kuomintang!

The circular to be addressed to seamen throughout
the country is as follows:-
"Since the September 18 and the January 28 Incidents,
national calamities have occurred and the bandit terror
has increased daily. The people are facing ruin. At
the present stage when the Government forces are intent
upon the bandit-Communist suppression campaign, the rebellion
in Fokien has broken out. The rebels including Chen Ming-
shu and Li Chi-sen, taking advantage of the fact that the
Government is facing civil war and foreign aggression,
gathered reactionary elements of the Chinese Communist
Party, the Third Party and the Social Democratic Party
and formed the People's Government. Not only did they
destroy the portrait of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen and change
the national flag, but they conspired with Japan and signed
illegal treaties. Furthermore, they concluded a loan
agreement, united with the Communists, entered into a
military alliance with them and hindered the Government
bandit-Communist suppression campaign.
"We must urge the Central Government to exterminate
the rebels in Fokien."

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

STATEMENT REGARDING ARREST OF JAPANESE AT WOOSUNG CONTRADICTED.

Several days ago, a certain local Chinese newspaper
published a report that Japanese disguised as hunters were
arrested by Chinese soldiers for entering the Woosung Forts
and the Lion Forts. The report continued that as a result
of negotiations made by the local Japanese Consulate with
the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters,

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

PANIC REIGNS IN FOOCHOW

Since the occupation of Yien Ping by the
Nationalist Army; the people at Foochow have become panic-
stricken.
The Fukien rebels are now building defences
around Foochow. The wealthy citizens of Foochow have
left for Hongkong or Shanghai. Business at Foochow
is almost completely suspended.
For the past two months, only the s.s. Chieh
Seng of the Indo-China Steamship Company and three
steamers of the Osaka Steamship Company have been plying
between Shanghai and Foochow. A deck passage on the
s.s. Chieh Seng costs $50 and a cabin $40 extra. Formerly
a deck passage was $7. The compradore of the s.s. Chieh
Seng makes a profit of $2,000 on each journey
A large quantity of provisions have been
transported to Foochow. The s.s. Chieh Seng also
conveyed 400 refugees to Shanghai on her last trip. It
is estimated that thousands of people have fled to
Shanghai, Hongkong, and Amoy.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

Precautionary Measures to Forestall Activities of
Fokien Agents.

The 200 reactionaries employed by the bogus
organisation (Fokien Government) are either members of
the Third Party, or the Communist Party or adherents of
Generals Lee Tsi-sun and Chen Min-hsu. They have been
commissioned to create disturbances in the provinces of
Kiangsu and Chekiang, especially in Shanghai, Nanking,
Hangchow and other hsiens on the border of the Chekiang
Province. They will obstruct transportation and spread
rumours. It is reported that these reactionaries will
arrive at Shanghai by steamers disguised as merchants
and labourers.
Upon learning of this, Colonel Wen Hoong-en,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau, ordered the various
subordinate police stations to adopt strict precautionary
measures on the boundaries of various districts and
assistance will also be rendered by the Peace Preservation
Corps of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters and the various district volunteers corps.
Commercial stores and private residences will be searched
and the Settlement Police authorities are requested to
search hotels and boarding houses in the Settlement.
Search parties will be conducted at the following
points:-
1. The North Railway Station and Paoshan Road
intersection.
2. The platforms at the South Railway Station.
3. All wharves and jetties.
4. The Hungjao and the Lunghwa Aerodromes where the
passengers will be searched by detectives and inspectors
of the Public Safety Bureau.

福州恐慌弥漫

自从国民革命军占领延平以来，福州民众陷入恐慌。
福建叛军目前正在福州周围修筑防御工事。福州富商已前往香港或上海。福州的商业几乎完全停顿。
过去两个月，只有印度支那轮船公司的“捷生”轮和大阪轮船公司的三艘轮船在上海和福州之间航行。“捷生”轮的甲板票价为50元，舱位另加40元。以前甲板票价仅为7元。“捷生”轮的买办每次航行可获利2,000美元。
大量物资已运往福州。“捷生”轮在上次航行中还运送了400名难民到上海。估计已有数千人逃往上海、香港和厦门。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

防范福建代理人活动的预防措施。

伪组织（福建政府）雇用的200名反动分子，要么是第三党成员，要么是共产党成员，或者是李济深和陈铭枢将军的追随者。他们受命在江苏和浙江各省，特别是上海、南京、杭州以及浙江省边境的其他县制造骚乱。他们将阻碍交通并散布谣言。据报道，这些反动分子将伪装成商人和劳工乘轮船抵达上海。
获悉此情况后，公安局局长温应星上校命令各下属警察分局在各区边界采取严格的预防措施，吴淞上海警备司令部总部的保安队和各區志愿队也将提供协助。将对商业店铺和私人住宅进行搜查，并请求租界警务当局搜查租界内的旅馆和寄宿处。
将在以下地点进行搜查：-
1. 北站与宝山路交叉口。
2. 南站站台。
3. 所有码头和栈桥。
4. 虹桥和龙华机场，乘客将由公安局的侦探和督察进行检查。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

OPPOSITION TO THE INCREASE IN THE BOARDING HOUSE TAX.

The Chinese Ratepayers Association of the French
Concession received the following letter from the
Shanghai Boarding House Keepers Association:-
"Some time ago, we wrote you a letter requesting
you to lodge a protest with the French Municipal Council
in connection with an increase in the amount of the tax
levied on three members of our Association, the Central,
the Dah Dong and the Sin Tu Boarding Houses.
"We are at a loss to understand why the French
Municipal Council should have increased the tax, for
the three boarding houses have done nothing against the law.
"Since the authorization of the increase by
the French Municipal Council, the tax has been collected
for two months. Should you not take up the matter strongly
with the French authorities, the tax for the third month
will be collected.
"The duty of your Association is to protect
the interests of the Chinese residents in the Concession.
We would therefore request you to continue the efforts
toward securing the abolition of the increase."
It is understood that the Ratepayers Association
has addressed another communication to the French Municipal
Council pressing for a definite answer to the request
already submitted.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

REPORT CONCERNING FUKIEN GOVERNMENT AGENTS AT SHANGHAI
DENIED.

On December 20, the local Japanese newspapers
published a report that Tsang Hsiang (張襄), the former
Chief-of-Staff of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioners
Headquarters and one named Zao (趙), Chief of the "Base
Office" of the 19th Route Army, have been detailed by the
Fukien Government to conduct activities in Shanghai.
When interviewed by a reporter of the Lin Yien
News Agency at his residence, Mr. Tsang denied these
allegations and stated that prior to the Fukien movement
he left here for Fukien to visit his relatives and friends
there and returned here immediately after the commencement
of the Fukien movement and that since then he has lived
quietly. He added that he does not communicate with
any one at Fukien.
In conclusion, he said that the allegations
published in the Japanese newspapers were groundless and
that there was no one by the name of Zao in the 19th
Route Army.

December 21, 1933.    Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

THE DEATH OF DALAI LAMA.

The Thibet Office at Nanking has received a telegram reporting the death of the Dalai Lama and stating that Sz Luen, the Finance Commissioner, and Kuh Auh, the Political Commissioner, are now responsible for the administration of Thibet.
The Nanking Thibet Office has sent a telegram to Sz Luen and Kuh Auh urging them to instruct officers and men of the Thibetan Armies not to resort to any military activities pending instructions from the Central Government.
An officer of the Nanking Thibet Office states that should an infant be born in Thibet at the time of the death of the Dalai Lama, he will be the Lama's successor according to the customs of Thibet.
The will of the Dalai Lama vigorously advocates Buddhism and condemns Catholicism and other religions. Sz Luen and Kuh Auh are instructed to act in compliance with the will of the Lama and continue to support the Central Government.
The representative of Thibet at Nanking has submitted a report on the death of the Dalai Lama to the Administrative Yuan and the Mongolian & Thibetan Affairs Committee.
It is reported that the Central Government will discuss the Thibetan question at a meeting to be held on December 21.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

LOCAL SILK FILATURES BANKRUPT.

Owing to trade depression, all local silk filatures have suspended operations, throwing more than 50,000 female workers out of employment.
The workers have appealed to the local Kuomintang and other Chinese political organs for relief.

Shun Pao (Nanking telegram):-

FUKIEN REBELS PLAN DISTURBANCES IN SHANGHAI AND HANGCHOW

According to information secured from military circles, the Fukien rebels have organized three groups to create disturbances in Hangchow and Shanghai.
Ying Yi Chung, a disciple of the notorious Communist leader Peng Tek Huai, has been appointed Secretary-General of the Propaganda Department of the organization. He is now in Shanghai planning to conduct activities.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

达赖喇嘛逝世。

南京蒙藏委员会收到电报，报告达赖喇嘛逝世，并称财政委员司伦（Sz Luen，音译）和政治委员酷阿（Kuh Auh，音译）现负责西藏行政事务。
南京蒙藏委员会已向司伦和酷阿发电，促请他们指示藏军官兵在等待中央政府指令期间，不得进行任何军事活动。
南京蒙藏委员会一位官员表示，若达赖喇嘛逝世时西藏有婴儿出生，按照西藏习俗，该婴儿将成为达赖的继承人。
达赖喇嘛的遗嘱极力推崇佛教，谴责天主教及其他宗教。司伦和酷阿奉命遵照达赖遗嘱行事，并继续支持中央政府。
西藏驻南京代表已向行政院及蒙藏委员会提交关于达赖喇嘛逝世的报告。
据报道，中央政府将在12月21日举行的会议上讨论西藏问题。

本地丝厂破产。

由于贸易萧条，本地所有丝厂均已停工，导致5万多名女工失业。
工人们已向本地国民党及其他中国政治机构呼吁救济。

福建叛军计划在沪杭制造骚乱

FUKIEN REBELS ESTABLISH RADIO STATION IN SHANGHAI

During his tenure of office as Chief of the
First Department of the Ministry of War, General Li Chi

Sin Wan Pao (Hangchow Telegram):
Rumours are rife in the city of Puchon that there have been skirmishes between the outposts of the government troops and the rebel forces at Liencu but that major engagements have not yet materialised.
Hsu Bei-ken, Director of the Aviation Bureau, stated that there were three routes open for the Fukien rebels to invade Chekiang; to invade Changshan from Siyakwan, to invade Taishen from Pingnan and Shuning, or to invade Pingyang from Yapu and Footing.

Sin Wan Pao (Nanking Telegram):
To deal with the Fukien invasion, the Central Government in addition to stationing a large number of troops at the Western and Southern parts of Chekiang despatched a strong army engaged in bandit suppression in Kiangsi to the front near Fukien.

Sin Wan Pao (Hankow Telegram)

THE FUKIEN SECESSION MOVEMENT

Information in the possession of a certain official organ revealed that the Fukien insurgents intend to invade Chekiang with a view to occupying Hangchow and Shanghai.
Ying I-chung, a henchman of the Communist leader, Pan Teh-hwei, has been appointed Chief Secretary to the Propaganda Department by the rebel government and sent to Shanghai to direct the reactionary movement. In addition, members of the Hung Hui Tong of Canton have been detailed to proceed to Shanghai to enlist loafers to be paid $2.00 a day to create disturbances.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

CHINESE POLICE TRAINING SCHOOL OPENED

At 10 a.m. yesterday the new Police Training
School of the Public Safety Bureau situated on Loong Hwa
Road off Tan Poo Road, was formally opened.
Major Wu Ta-chen; General Wen Gen Kung, Chief of
the Public Safety Bureau and over 200 others were present.
General Wen who presided over the inauguration
ceremony, delivered a speech in which he stated that the
school was formerly established in Chekiang and later
closed down owing to the Shanghai War.
Major Wu also gave a speech exhorting the
policemen to study hard during the training course in
order to be of use to the country.

Central China Daily News:

NATIVE GOODS EXHIBITION TO BE POSTPONED

The Special District Native Goods Exhibition was
banned by the Fire Brigade of the S.M.C. on the ground
that the arrangements were not in conformity with the
plan submitted. A meeting of representatives of the
manufacturers was held in the evening of the 16th and
the following notification was issued:-
"The Native Goods Movement Exhibition was scheduled
to be opened on the 18th, but owing to the opposition
of the Shanghai Municipal Council to the arrangements,
the exhibition has been postponed until New Year Day."

Shun Pao (Hangchow telegram):-

SENTRIES AT NORTHERN FUKIEN CLASH WITH REBELS

The sentries of the Central Army at Northern
Fukien yesterday had a minor conflict with the advancing
rebel force at Chien An and Yien Ping area. The
Central Army has not yet been ordered to launch an
attack. Reinforcements have already been sent from Chekiang
to the southern front.
A telegram from Chuchow states that General
Chiang Tin Wen is now leading the main force to meet
the rebels.
Another telegram from Hangchow states that
General Lu Te Ping, Chairman of the Chekiang Province,
made a tour of inspection at 5 p.m. December 17 on the
southern frontier. The border of Chekiang has been
strongly fortified. The Fukien rebels are now
joining the Communist forces at Yien Ping.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

WHARF WORKERS' DISPUTE AT POOTUNG

The Yung Ling(榮麟) Wharf at Pootung has been
leased by the Yu Chang(裕昌) Coal Store. The coolies
working on this wharf were formerly under the control
of a contractor named Lee Hung Kee(李鴻記). Recently
the Coal Store has taken over the wharf and has abolished
the workers contract system. The manager of the
Hwa Lun(華倫) Company, No.10 Canton Road, was engaged
to act as overseer and new coolies were engaged.
Opposition was raised by Lee Hung Kee, the former
contractor, who claimed that he should continue to act
as overseer and refused to hand over the wharf to the
new workers. A dispute arose, which caused the
Company to sustain a loss of $20,000. Work on the
wharf is suspended.
On December 3, some 400 wharf coolies detailed
five representatives to submit an appeal to the Company
requesting that they should be allowed to resume work
immediately.
The Yung Ling Company then made an agreement
with the coolies and work was to be resumed on December
12. Copies of the agreement have been sent to the
Social Bureau, the Bureau of Public Safety and other
political organs for consideration.
However, when these coolies tried to unload
a shipment of coal on December 12, Lee Hung Kee led
some 100 coolies to the wharf and interfered with the
work. The Bureau of Public Safety at once sent a
detachment of Police to the scene and work was again
suspended.
Yesterday morning, the Bureau of Social Affairs
called a meeting of representatives from both sides.
The dispute may be settled to-day.

浦东码头工人纠纷

浦东的荣麟（Yung Ling）码头已由裕昌（Yu Chang）煤号承租。在该码头工作的苦力原先受一名叫李鸿记（Lee Hung Kee）的包工头控制。最近，该煤号接管了码头，并废除了工人包工制度。广东路10号华伦（Hwa Lun）公司的经理被聘为监工，并雇佣了新的苦力。前包工头李鸿记提出反对，声称他应继续担任监工，并拒绝将码头移交给新工人。由此引发纠纷，导致该公司损失2万美元。码头工作已暂停。
12月3日，约400名码头苦力推选出五名代表向公司提交请愿书，请求允许他们立即复工。
随后，荣麟公司与苦力达成协议，定于12月12日复工。协议副本已送交社会局、公安局及其他政治机关审议。
然而，当这些苦力于12月12日试图卸载一批煤炭时，李鸿记率领约100名苦力来到码头干扰工作。公安局立即派遣一队警察前往现场，工作再次暂停。

Society Mercury (社會新聞), a 3-day periodical:-

ACTIVITIES OF ADHERENTS OF SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC PARTY IN
SHANGHAI.

The senior members of the Social Democratic Party
in Shanghai are doing nothing beyond patronizing cinemas
and dance halls. The officials of the Fukien new
Government are criticizing them for inefficiency. Taking
advantage of the circumstances, the cunning agents including
one named Yue (余) have demanded money and suggested
calling a "General Meeting of Representatives of Various
Public Bodies in Shanghai in Support of the Fukien People's
Government." During the past three days, certain agents
distributed handbills in quiet terraces in the evenings.
A certain member of the Democratic Party has stated that
street loafers can be easily employed at a cost of $300
or $500 to distribute handbills.
It is ascertained that the contents of the handbills
condemn the Kuomintang Government.

DUTY ON FOREIGN GOODS.

The Ministry of Finance is proposing to collect a
duty on the following foreign goods from January 1, 1934:-
Cotton, silk, cotton thread, satin, tea, piece cloth,
lumber, fish, matches and lamps.
It is learned that the levy of the import duty on
foreign rice and wheat will commence this year.

DISSATISFACTION OF FINANCE MINISTER DENIED.

In a press interview yesterday, Mayor Wu Te-chen
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai stated that the
report alleging that Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister of Finance,
was dissatisfied is entirely untrue.

Communications is carrying out an inspection of tug-boats
plying in the rivers inland.

to the various Navigation Bureaux stating that all seamen must
possess licences.

December 9, 1933.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

ACTIVITIES OF AGENTS OF FOKIEN AT SHANGHAI

Preparations are being made by the new Fokien organization to attack Chekiang. Agents have been commissioned to come to Shanghai and endeavour to induce less important politicians here to convene a meeting to be known as "The General Meeting of Representatives of People of Various Walks of Life of Shanghai to Support the Fokien People's Government." The Fokien Government will appoint one named Liu Vung Van (劉文范) to attend the forthcoming representatives meeting. It is proposed to issue a manifesto and handbills containing slogans are to be distributed. It is learned that Tsi Gee Sung (資紀松), Yu Mou Dao (余某道), Yang Pah Kai (楊伯凱), Liu Ching Yuen (劉景元), Chang Ts Ping (張資平) and others will preside at the function.

Fokien agents in this city are calling on the Consular Body to explain the policy of the Fokien organization. According to a statement made by the agents, the Fokien People's Government is not a Communist Government, despite the fact that the Government has concluded an agreement with the Red Army.

Chang Ts Ping, one of the active agents of Fokien in Shanghai, is discussing affairs with Japanese named C. Tanaka and N. Nakamura.

Government Delegates to Proceed to Canton To-day.

The five delegates of the Central Government will leave Shanghai for Hongkong on the morning of December 9 on board the S.S. "President Pierce."

Fokien Negotiates Loan with Japan.

According to a Hongkong telegram, the Fokien secessionists have negotiated a loan amounting to $30,000,000 with Japan.

在本市的福建代理人正在拜访领事团，解释福建组织的政策。据代理人称，尽管福建政府已与红军达成协议，但福建人民政府并非共产主义政府。

张资平是福建在上海的活跃代理人之一，他正与名叫 C. Tanaka 和 N. Nakamura 的日本人商讨事务。

福建分裂运动——《大美晚报》中文版因被指进行亲福建宣传而被剥夺邮政便利

遵照交通部命令，位于爱多亚路15-17号的美商机构《大美晚报》（Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury）中文版，自1933年11月25日起，因涉嫌进行亲福建宣传而被剥夺邮政便利。
此前曾提及，该报因同样原因于11月24日被禁止在华方控制区域销售（参见1933年11月25日情报报告）。

福建同乡会——会议

上述协会九名委员于12月6日下午2时至4时30分在其福州路512号办事处开会。出席者之一的谢荫波（Tia Ying-poo）担任主席。会议讨论了收到的一封来自厦门商会的信件，信中告知该会中央政府飞机最近轰炸了泉州（Chuanchow）。会议决定请求蒋介石将军指令政府空军避免执行可能危及福建平民生命财产的行动。

December 6, 1933. Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

NICHI-NICHI

FUKIEN GOVERNMENT TO PURCHASE MILITARY AEROPLANES
FROM AMERICA

A Dentsu telegram from Tokyo
dated December 5 reports that according to reliable
sources the Fukien Government is about to purchase
military aeroplanes from America and is offering King-
men Island to America as payment.
The Japanese authorities attach much
importance to the matter because this procedure violates
the treaty in which China agreed (to) not entrust any
part of Fukien to other powers.

CHINESE BURN JAPANESE GOODS

A Changsha telegram dated
December 4 reports that the Anti-Japanese Associations
there have destroyed a quantity of Japanese goods seized
some time ago.

MAINICHI

ARRIVAL MR. MORISHIMA

Mr. Morishima, Chief of the
First Section of the Asia Bureau of the Tokyo Government,
arrived in Shanghai at 4 p.m. yesterday.

INAUGURATION OF GRAND ASIA ASSOCIATION IN DAIREN

A Dairen telegram dated December 5
reports that an inauguration meeting of the Grand Asia
Association organized by S. Ohkawa, Z. Inabata, Ex M.P.,
Chang Yen Keng, Manchukuo Minister of Industry, Patrap,
and Nile, will be held in Dairen on February 11, 1934.
The Grand Asia Association is supported by the Black
Dragon Association under the leadership of Mr. M. Toyama
and R. Uchita, the Jinmu Association under the leadership
of Dr. S. Ohkawa and the Red Swastika Association.

NIPPO

ARRIVAL OF ADMIRAL TAKSU

Rear-Admiral Takasu, newly appointed
staff officer of the Third Fleet, arrived in Shanghai
at 2:30 p.m. yesterday. He was the chief judge in
the May 15 case.

杂项

《日日新闻》（NICHI-NICHI）

福建政府拟从美国购买军用飞机

东京12月5日电通社电讯报道称，据可靠消息来源，福建政府正准备从美国购买军用飞机，并提议以金门岛作为支付手段。
日本当局对此事高度重视，因为此举违反了中国同意不将福建任何部分委托给其他列强的条约。

中国人焚烧日货

长沙12月4日电讯报道称，当地的反日协会销毁了一批此前查获的日货。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

森岛先生抵达

东京政府亚洲局第一科科长森岛先生于昨日下午4时抵达上海。

大连大亚细亚协会成立

大连12月5日电讯报道称，由大川周明（S. Ohkawa）、稻畑贞二（Z. Inabata，前议员）、张燕卿（Chang Yen Keng，满洲国产业大臣）、Patrap（音译）和 Nile（音译）组织的大亚细亚协会成立大会将于1934年2月11日在大连举行。大亚细亚协会得到头山满（M. Toyama）和内田良平（R. Uchita）领导下的黑龙会、大川周明博士领导下的神武会以及红卍字会的支持。

《日本新闻》（NIPPO）

高须中将抵达

新任第三舰队参谋高须四郎少将（Rear-Admiral Takasu）于昨日下午2时30分抵达上海。他曾是五一五案件的主审法官。

Morning Translation

December 6, 1933.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

MILITARY ACTIVITIES AT FUKIEN

According to the statement of people who have
recently travelled from Fukien, the Fukien authorities
have appointed Chieu Chao Sen, vanguard commander, to
launch an offensive on the Chekiang Border. General
Tan Chi Sieu, Commander of the 5th Route Army at Fukien,
is now making military preparations in North Fukien.

The Headquarters of the Commander-in-chief
General Tsai Tin Kai are now at Foochow. Chekiang will
be attacked from two directions. The Central Army is
also prepared for action.

《顺天时报》（Shun Pao）及其他本地报纸：

福建的军事活动

据近期从福建旅行归来的人士称，福建当局已任命赵森（Chieu Chao Sen，音译）为先锋指挥官，向浙江边境发动进攻。驻福建的第五路军总指挥谭启秀（Tan Chi Sieu，音译）将军目前正在闽北进行军事准备。

总司令蔡廷锴（Tsai Tin Kai）将军的总部现设在福州。将从两个方向进攻浙江。中央军也已做好行动准备。
